cases.translation: “Nothing, ma’am,” she replied; “only--only I must have displeased you somehow, since you wish to dismiss me from the house. cases.sentence: Она вынула из-под платка корнет, сделанный из ___, в котором были две карамельки и одна винная ягода, и дрожащей рукой подала его мне.
cases.explain: «красной бумаги» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Seeing my fury, Natalia departed, while I continued to strut about and plan how to punish the bold woman for her offence. Yet not more than a few moments had passed when Natalia returned and, stealing to my side, began to comfort me, “Hush, then, my love. Do not cry. Forgive me my rudeness. It was wrong of me. You WILL pardon me, my darling, will you not? There, there, that’s a dear,” and she took from her handkerchief a cornet of pink paper containing two little cakes and a grape, and offered it me with a trembling hand. I could not look the kind old woman in the face, but, turning aside, took the paper, while my tears flowed the faster--though from love and shame now, not from anger.
